रोदन n. (-नं)
 1. Weeping, crying.
 2. A tear, tears.
 f. (-नी) A plant,
(Hedysarum alhagi.)
 E. रुद् to weep, aff. ल्युट् ।

. Earth. Dual. (-सी) Heaven and earth.
 E. रुद्
to weep, aff. असुन् ।

रोदसी f. (-सी)
 1. Heaven, paradise.
 2. Earth.
 f. Dual. (-स्यी) Heaven and
earth.
 E. ङीप् added to the preceding.
